# Spook actions

Call these like any other action, as `domain.action`, with fields under `data:` and the target under `target:`. Many of them live on the domain they act on, not on `spook`.

## automation

### `automation.snooze`: Snooze

Turns an automation off for a while, and turns it back on when the time is up.

Target: `automation` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `duration` (required, duration): How long the automation stays off. It comes back on by itself when this is up, a restart of Home Assistant in between included. Example: `01:00:00`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/automation#snooze

### `automation.turn_on_for`: Turn on for

Turns an automation on for a while, and turns it back off when the time is up.

Target: `automation` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `duration` (required, duration): How long the automation stays on. It goes back off by itself when this is up, a restart of Home Assistant in between included. Example: `01:00:00`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/automation#turn-on-for

Import a blueprint.

Data:

- `url` (required, text): The URL to import the blueprint from.

## calendar

### `calendar.delete_event`: Delete event

Deletes events from a calendar, found by their title or uid in a stretch of time. Hands back what it deleted, uid included.

Response: on request.

Target: `calendar` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `summary` (optional, text): The title of the events to delete, exactly as it is in the calendar. Example: `Dentist`.
- `uid` (optional, text): The identifier of the event to delete, for when you have it.
- `start_date_time` (optional, datetime): Where to start looking. Defaults to now. Example: `2026-10-04 08:00:00`.
- `end_date_time` (optional, datetime): Where to stop looking. Give this or a duration. Example: `2026-10-04 20:00:00`.
- `duration` (optional, duration): How far to look from the start. Give this or an end date and time.
- `whole_series` (optional, boolean): For a recurring event, delete the whole series rather than only the occurrence that was found. Default: `false`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/calendar#delete-event

### `calendar.update_event`: Update event

Changes events in a calendar, found by their title or uid in a stretch of time. Hands back what it changed, uid included.

Response: on request.

Target: `calendar` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `summary` (optional, text): The title of the events to change, exactly as it is in the calendar. Example: `Dentist`.
- `uid` (optional, text): The identifier of the event to change, for when you have it.
- `start_date_time` (optional, datetime): Where to start looking. Defaults to now. Example: `2026-10-04 08:00:00`.
- `end_date_time` (optional, datetime): Where to stop looking. Give this or a duration. Example: `2026-10-04 20:00:00`.
- `duration` (optional, duration): How far to look from the start. Give this or an end date and time.
- `new_summary` (optional, text): The title to give the events. Example: `Orthodontist`.
- `description` (optional, text): The description to give the events.
- `location` (optional, text): The location to give the events.
- `new_start` (optional, datetime): When the events start instead. They keep their length, unless a new end is given too.
- `new_end` (optional, datetime): When the events end instead.
- `shift` (optional, duration): Move the events by this much, later, or earlier when negative. Instead of a new start or end.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/calendar#update-event

## climate

### `climate.decrease_temperature`: Decrease temperature

Turns a thermostat's setpoint down a step, both setpoints for one that heats and cools. A thermostat that is off stays off.

Target: `climate` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `step` (optional, number, 0.1 to 10): How much to change it by. Leave it out to use the thermostat's own step, or half a degree (one in Fahrenheit) when it has none. Example: `0.5`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/climate#decrease-temperature

### `climate.increase_temperature`: Increase temperature

Turns a thermostat's setpoint up a step, both setpoints for one that heats and cools. A thermostat that is off stays off.

Target: `climate` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `step` (optional, number, 0.1 to 10): How much to change it by. Leave it out to use the thermostat's own step, or half a degree (one in Fahrenheit) when it has none. Example: `0.5`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/climate#increase-temperature

## counter

### `counter.create`: Create a counter

Creates a new counter helper on the fly. Returns the entity ID of the new counter.

Data:

- `name` (required, text): The name of the new counter.
- `counter_id` (optional, text): The entity ID for the new counter. The counter. prefix is added automatically. If not provided, the entity ID will be generated based on the name.
- `initial` (optional, number): The value the counter starts at, and goes back to on a reset. Default: `0`.
- `minimum` (optional, number): The lowest value the counter can go down to. Leave out for no limit.
- `maximum` (optional, number): The highest value the counter can go up to. Leave out for no limit.
- `step` (optional, number): How much the counter goes up or down by each time. Default: `1`.
- `restore` (optional, boolean): Restore the value of the counter when Home Assistant starts, rather than starting over at the initial value. Default: `true`.
- `icon` (optional, icon): The icon for the new counter.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/counter#create-a-counter

### `counter.delete`: Delete a counter

Deletes counter helpers made in the UI or with the create a counter action. Counters set up in YAML cannot be deleted by Spook.

Data:

- `entity_id` (required, entity, one or a list): The counter(s) to delete.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/counter#delete-a-counter

## cover

### `cover.decrease_position`: Decrease position

Moves a cover a step further closed, stopping at fully closed.

Target: `cover` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `step` (optional, number, 1 to 100 %): How many percent to move it by. Ten percent when left out. Default: `10`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/cover#decrease-position

### `cover.increase_position`: Increase position

Moves a cover a step further open, stopping at fully open.

Target: `cover` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `step` (optional, number, 1 to 100 %): How many percent to move it by. Ten percent when left out. Default: `10`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/cover#increase-position

## group

### `group.add_members`: Add members to a group

Adds entities to a group made through the interface, while Home Assistant is running. Entities already in the group are left where they are.

Data:

- `group` (required, entity): The group to add to. Example: `light.hallway`.
- `members` (required, entity, one or a list): The entities to add to the group.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/group#add-members-to-a-group

### `group.remove_members`: Remove members from a group

Takes entities out of a group made through the interface, while Home Assistant is running. Naming something that is not in the group does nothing, so this is also how you clear out a member that no longer exists.

Data:

- `group` (required, entity): The group to take them out of. Example: `light.hallway`.
- `members` (required, entity, one or a list): The entities to remove from the group.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/group#remove-members-from-a-group

### `group.set_members`: Set the members of a group

Replaces the members of a group made through the interface with the ones given, while Home Assistant is running.

Data:

- `group` (required, entity): The group to change. Example: `light.hallway`.
- `members` (required, entity, one or a list): The entities the group should hold from now on.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/group#set-the-members-of-a-group

### `homeassistant.unexpose_entity`: Stop exposing an entity to assistants

### `homeassistant.unhide_entity`: Unhide an entity

Unhides an entity (or entities) on the fly.

### `homeassistant.update_category`: Update a category

Updates an existing category on the fly. Anything you leave out keeps the value it already has. The icon can be cleared by setting it to null.

### `homeassistant.update_entity_id`: Update an entity's ID

Updates an entity's ID on the fly.

Data:

- `new_entity_id` (required, text): The new ID for the entity.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/entities#update-an-entitys-id

### `homeassistant.update_label`: Update a label

Updates an existing label on the fly. Anything you leave out keeps the value it already has. The description, icon and color can be cleared by setting them to null.

Data:

## input_number

### `input_number.create`: Create an input number

Create a new input number helper on the fly. Returns the entity ID of the new input number.

Data:

- `name` (required, text): The name of the new input number helper.
- `input_number_id` (optional, text): The entity ID for the new input number helper. The input_number. prefix is added automatically. If not provided, the entity ID will be generated based on the name.
- `min` (optional, number): The minimum value of the input number. Default: `0`.
- `max` (optional, number): The maximum value of the input number. Default: `100`.
- `initial` (optional, number): The initial value of the input number when Home Assistant starts.
- `step` (optional, number): The step size of the input number. Default: `1`.
- `mode` (optional, one of `slider`, `box`): The display mode of the input number, which can be either a slider or an input box. Default: `slider`.
- `icon` (optional, icon): The icon to use for the input number helper.
- `unit_of_measurement` (optional, text): The unit of measurement of the input number.

### `input_number.decrement`: Decrease value

Decrease an input number entity value by a certain amount.

Target: `input_number` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `amount` (optional, number): The amount to decrease the input number with. If not provided, the step of the number entity will be used.
- `cycle` (optional, boolean): Carry on from the other end of the range instead of stopping at this one, the same way selecting the next option cycles a select. Default: `false`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/input-number#decrease-value

### `input_number.delete`: Delete an input number

Deletes input number helpers made in the UI or with the create an input number action. Input numbers set up in YAML cannot be deleted by Spook.

Data:

- `entity_id` (required, entity, one or a list): The input number(s) to delete.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/input-number#delete-an-input-number

### `input_number.increment`: Increase value

Increase an input number entity value by a certain amount.

Target: `input_number` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `amount` (optional, number): The amount to increase the input number with. If not provided, the step of the number entity will be used.
- `cycle` (optional, boolean): Carry on from the other end of the range instead of stopping at this one, the same way selecting the next option cycles a select. Default: `false`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/input-number#increase-value

### `input_number.max`: Set maximum value

Set an input number entity to its maximum value.

Target: `input_number` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/input-number#set-value-to-maximum

### `input_number.min`: Set minimum value

Set an input number entity to its minimum value.

Target: `input_number` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/input-number#set-value-to-minimum

### `input_number.set_range`: Set range

Changes the minimum, maximum or step of an input number made in the UI, the same as editing it. A value outside the new range is moved inside it.

Target: `input_number` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `max` (optional, number): The new maximum value. Example: `3600`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/input-number#set-range

## input_select

### `input_select.create`: Create an input select

Creates a new input select (dropdown) helper on the fly. Returns the entity ID of the new input select.

Data:

- `name` (required, text): The name of the new input select.
- `input_select_id` (optional, text): The entity ID for the new input select. The input_select. prefix is added automatically. If not provided, the entity ID will be generated based on the name.
- `options` (required, text, one or a list): The options to choose from. Each option can only be in it once.

### `input_select.delete`: Delete an input select

Deletes input select helpers made in the UI or with the create an input select action. Input selects set up in YAML cannot be deleted by Spook.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/input-select#delete-an-input-select

### `input_select.random`: Select random option

Select a random option for an input_select entity.

Target: `input_select` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `options` (optional, object): Limits the options to select from. If not provided, all options will be considered.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/input-select#select-random-option

### `input_select.reverse`: Reverse options

Reverses the order of the selectable options for an `input_select` entity, back to front. This is not persistent and will be undone once reloaded or Home Assistant restarts.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/input-select#reverse-options

### `input_select.shuffle`: Shuffle options

Shuffles the list of selectable options for an `input_select` entity. This is not persistent and will be undone once reloaded or Home Assistant restarts.

Target: `input_select` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/input-select#shuffle-options

### `input_select.sort`: Sort options

Sorts the list of selectable options for an `input_select` entity. This is not persistent and will be undone once reloaded or Home Assistant restarts.

Target: `input_select` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/input-select#sort-options

## light

### `light.decrease_brightness`: Decrease brightness

Turns down the lights that are already on, stopping at the dimmest they go rather than switching them off.

Target: `light` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `step_pct` (required, number, 1 to 100 %): How much dimmer to go, as a percentage. Each light steps from its own level, so a group keeps its shape instead of levelling out. Example: `10`.
- `transition` (optional, number, 0 to 300 seconds): How long the change should take, in seconds. Example: `2`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/light#decrease-brightness

### `light.increase_brightness`: Increase brightness

Turns up the lights that are already on, and leaves the ones that are off alone.

Target: `light` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `step_pct` (required, number, 1 to 100 %): How much brighter to go, as a percentage. Each light steps from its own level, so a group keeps its shape instead of levelling out. Example: `10`.
- `transition` (optional, number, 0 to 300 seconds): How long the change should take, in seconds. Example: `2`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/light#increase-brightness

### `light.set_brightness`: Set brightness

Sets the brightness of lights that are already on, and leaves the ones that are off alone.

Target: `light` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `brightness_pct` (required, number, 1 to 100 %): The brightness to set, as a percentage. Groups are adjusted light by light, so a light that is off stays off. Example: `50`.
- `transition` (optional, number, 0 to 300 seconds): How long the change should take, in seconds. Example: `2`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/light#set-brightness

### `light.set_color`: Set color

Sets the color of lights that are already on, and leaves alone the ones that are off or cannot do color.

Target: `light` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `rgb_color` (required, color_rgb): The color to set. Lights that cannot do color are passed over rather than turned white. Example: `[255, 100, 100]`.
- `transition` (optional, number, 0 to 300 seconds): How long the change should take, in seconds. Example: `2`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/light#set-color

### `light.set_color_temperature`: Set color temperature

Sets the color temperature of lights that are already on, each within the range it can actually reach.

Target: `light` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `kelvin` (required, color_temp): The color temperature to set. Every light is held to its own range, since warm white on one lamp is a number another cannot reach. Example: `2700`.
- `transition` (optional, number, 0 to 300 seconds): How long the change should take, in seconds. Example: `2`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/light#set-color-temperature

### `light.set_effect`: Set effect

Sets an effect on the lights that are already on and actually have it.

Target: `light` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `effect` (required, text): The name of the effect to set. Effect names differ per manufacturer, so lights that do not have this one are left as they are. Example: `Colorloop`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/light#set-effect

## recorder

### `recorder.import_statistics`: Import statistics

Import long-term statistics.

Data:

- `statistic_id` (required, entity): The statistics ID (entity ID) to import for.
- `name` (optional, text): The name of the statistics.
- `source` (required, text): The source of the statistics data.
- `unit_of_measurement` (optional, text): The unit of measurement of the statistics.
- `has_mean` (required, boolean): If the statistics has a mean value.
- `has_sum` (required, boolean): If the statistics has a sum value.
- `stats` (required, object): A list of mappings/dictionaries with statistics to import. The dictionaries must contain a "start" key with a datetime string other valid options are "mean", "sum", "min", "max", "last_reset", and "state". All of those are optional and either an integer or a float, except for "last_reset" which is a datetime string.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/recorder#import-statistics

## repairs

### `repairs.create`: Create issue

Manually create and raise an issue in Home Assistant repairs.

Data:

- `title` (required, text): The title of the issue.
- `description` (required, text): The description of the issue. Supports Markdown.
- `issue_id` (optional, text): The issue can have an identifier, which allows you to cancel it later with that ID if needed. It also prevents duplicate issues to be created. If not provided, a random ID will be generated.
- `domain` (optional, text): This field can be used to set the domain of the issue. For example, by default (if not set), it will use "spook". This causes Spook to be shown in the logo/image of the issue. If you set it to "homeassistant", the Home Assistant logo will be used, or use "hue", "zwave_js", "mqtt", etc. to use the logo of that integration.
- `severity` (optional, one of `warning`, `error`, `critical`): The severity of the issue. This will be used to determine the priority of the issue. If not set, "warning" will be used.
- `persistent` (optional, boolean): If the issue should be persistent, which means it will survive restarts of Home Assistant. By default, issues are not persistent.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/repairs#create-issue

### `repairs.ignore_all`: Ignore all issues

Ignore all issues currently raised in Home Assistant Repairs, or only those raised by particular integrations.

Data:

- `domain` (optional, text, one or a list): Only ignore the issues raised by these integrations. Example: `hacs`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/repairs#ignore-all-issues

### `repairs.list`: List issues

Lists the issues currently raised in Home Assistant Repairs, with their titles, for an automation to act on or a dashboard to show.

Response: always. Call it asking for the response, or it fails.

Data:

- `include_ignored` (optional, boolean): Also list the issues that have been ignored. Default: `false`.
- `domain` (optional, text, one or a list): Only list the issues raised by these integrations. Example: `hue`.
- `severity` (optional, list, each one of `critical`, `error`, `warning`): Only list the issues with these severities.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/repairs#list-issues

### `repairs.remove`: Remove issue

Removes a manually created Home Assistant repairs issue. This action can only remove issues created with the `repairs_create` action.

Data:

- `issue_id` (required, text): The issue ID to remove.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/repairs#remove-issue

### `repairs.unignore_all`: Unignore all issues

Unignore all issues currently raised in Home Assistant Repairs, or only those raised by particular integrations.

Data:

- `domain` (optional, text, one or a list): Only unignore the issues raised by these integrations. Example: `hacs`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/repairs#unignore-all-issues

- `item` (required, text): The title or uid of the item to move. Example: `Take out the bins`.
- `after` (optional, text): The title or uid of the item to put it after. Give this or a position. Example: `Do the dishes`.
- `position` (optional, one of `top`, `bottom`): Move it to the top or the bottom of the list. Give this or an item to put it after.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/todo#move-item

## valve

### `valve.decrease_position`: Decrease position

Moves a valve a step further closed, stopping at fully closed.

Target: `valve` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `step` (optional, number, 1 to 100 %): How many percent to move it by. Ten percent when left out. Default: `10`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/valve#decrease-position

### `valve.increase_position`: Increase position

Moves a valve a step further open, stopping at fully open.

Target: `valve` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `step` (optional, number, 1 to 100 %): How many percent to move it by. Ten percent when left out. Default: `10`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/valve#increase-position

## water_heater

### `water_heater.decrease_temperature`: Decrease temperature

Turns a water heater's setpoint down a step, within its limits.

Target: `water_heater` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `step` (optional, number, 0.1 to 10): How much to change it by. Leave it out to use the water heater's own step, or half a degree (one in Fahrenheit) when it has none. Example: `1`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/water-heater#decrease-temperature

### `water_heater.increase_temperature`: Increase temperature

Turns a water heater's setpoint up a step, within its limits.

Target: `water_heater` entities, or the devices, areas, floors and labels holding them.

Data:

- `step` (optional, number, 0.1 to 10): How much to change it by. Leave it out to use the water heater's own step, or half a degree (one in Fahrenheit) when it has none. Example: `1`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/water-heater#increase-temperature

## zone

### `zone.create`: Create a zone

Create a new zone in Home Assistant on the fly.

Data:

- `name` (required, text): Name of the zone
- `icon` (optional, icon): Icon to use for the zone
- `latitude` (required, template): Latitude of the zone. This can be a template.
- `longitude` (required, template): Longitude of the zone. This can be a template.
- `radius` (optional, number, 0 to 999999999999 m): Radius of the zone Default: `100`.
- `passive` (optional, boolean): A passive zone is only there for automations: it is not shown on the map, and does not change where people and device trackers are. Default: `false`.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/zone#create-a-zone

### `zone.delete`: Delete a zone

Delete a zone. This works only with zones created and managed via the UI. Zones created and managed in YAML cannot be managed by Spook.

Data:

- `entity_id` (required, entity, one or a list): The ID of the entity (or entities) to remove.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/zone#delete-a-zone

### `zone.update`: Update a zone

Update properties of a zone on the fly.

Data:

- `entity_id` (required, entity): The ID of the entity (or entities) to update.
- `name` (optional, text): Name of the zone
- `icon` (optional, icon): Icon to use for the zone
- `latitude` (optional, template): Latitude of the zone. This can be a template.
- `longitude` (optional, template): Longitude of the zone. This can be a template.
- `radius` (optional, number, 0 to 999999999999 m): Radius of the zone Default: `100`.
- `passive` (optional, boolean): A passive zone is only there for automations: it is not shown on the map, and does not change where people and device trackers are.

Documentation: https://spook.boo/zone#update-a-zone
